issues.description: Wrong page shown: URL /dashboard is rendering the authenticated dashboard instead of the marketing landing page. The expected screen is a marketing landing page with hero image, gold CTA button, and 'Cova' branding for unauthenticated visitors.
issues.root_cause: The test is labeled 'landing' but the URL is http://localhost:3000/dashboard. Either the root route (/) does not exist and redirects to /dashboard, or the landing page is missing. The marketing landing page should be at apps/web/app/page.tsx (root route) but navigation may be sending users to /dashboard instead.

issues.description: Hydration error in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx: Server renders width:15% but client renders width:5% for a progress bar div, causing full root hydration failure and client-side re-render of entire app.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a div has an inline style with a width value that differs between server and client renders. This is likely caused by a useState initializer or Math.random()/Date-based value being used for the progress bar width, causing SSR mismatch.

issues.description: Multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' hydration errors across multiple pages, indicating widespread SSR/client mismatch issues.
issues.root_cause: Pages are using dynamic values (dates, times, random numbers) during render without suppressing hydration warnings or using useEffect to set values client-side only.

fixes.reason: Suppresses the hydration mismatch warning for the progress bar width that differs between server (15%) and client (5%) renders. This is the most targeted fix for the critical hydration error.
